_readme.purpose: CHA add-on products for the Command Center Add-Ons page.
_readme.source: FirstEnroll rate sheet and product catalog, NEO availability document, NEO storefront pricing. Verified product by product and state by state. Rechecked Oct 26 2026 against the live NEO (974021), FirstEnroll (974358) and Premier (745779) storefronts; Premier add-ons added from the Premier storefront and product STATES tabs. FirstEnroll add-on household rates and state lists confirmed in the FirstEnroll enrollment checkout (Oct 26 2026).
rules: states: null means the source document gave NO availability list. That is NOT the same as unavailable - it needs confirming on the platform before quoting.
states: an array means the source DID give a list. A state not in that array is genuinely unavailable - do not offer it.
Never collapse those two cases together.
price_member null with a price_note means show the note, never a figure.
is_discount_program true means the product is not insurance and must never be presented as coverage.
on_hold true means it cannot be sold today.
Prices are flat and do not vary by age.
state_lists are shared by several products. Do not re-derive or re-sort them.

fields.name: display name
fields.platform: FirstEnroll, NEO or Premier - the enrollment platform
fields.price_member: monthly rate for Member tier, or null
fields.tiers: monthly rates for spouse / children / family, or null. null inside means that tier has no published rate.
fields.price_note: shown instead of figures when there is no price
fields.plus_one: true = the portal prices Member + 1 (spouse or one child) as one rate; two or more children is the Family rate
